scenes.title: Who will you be?
text: Your name, how you look, the life you're leaving behind, and where your strengths lie. Everything else you'll earn by doing it.

scenes.title: The storm
text: Three days out from the southern ports, the sky turned the colour of a bruise.
By nightfall the storm had the little trade boat by the throat, and the crew had stopped pretending.
Someone was shouting about the mast. You never heard the rest.
Cold. Then dark. Then nothing at all.
Grey light. Sand in your mouth. The sea still tugging at your boots, as if it wants you back.
Footsteps on the sand. A rough old voice: "Easy now. You're not dead yet, and I'll not have you die on my beach."
He hauls you up the shore by the shoulders, step by slow step, to a hut that smells of smoke and fish.
